title: Corpay to Showcase Full-Service AP Automation at SuiteWorld
summary: Corpay to Showcase Full-Service AP Automation at SuiteWorld
body_markdown:
**Corpay to Showcase Full-Service AP Automation at SuiteWorld** **ATLANTA, GA. – October 13, 2026** – Corpay, the global spend management company, is excited to announce its participation as a sponsor at SuiteWorld, where the company will connect with NetSuite users and showcase its full-service approach to AP Automation.


Corpay’s AP Automation solution is a certified Built for NetSuite SuiteApp designed to help finance teams streamline supplier payments, strengthen controls, and reduce the manual work required after payments are made. Unlike solutions that focus primarily on invoice approvals and payment execution, Corpay helps manage the broader supplier payment lifecycle, including vendor servicing, payment follow-up, exception handling, reconciliation support, and active payment fraud monitoring.


As part of its SuiteWorld sponsorship, Corpay will host a speaking presentation titled, “The last mile of AP: The work that starts the moment a payment is approved.” The session will explore the “last mile” of supplier payments and focus awareness on the operational work taking place after payment approval. Attendees will learn where hidden workload and fraud risk commonly appear, why manual follow-up can limit ability to scale, and how a more comprehensive approach to AP automation can reduce that workload.


“Finance teams have made progress modernizing invoice intake processes to the point of actually making the payments, but the work does not stop when a payment file is released,” said Sven Hinrichsen, Corpay’s SuiteWorld session presenter. “A full-service AP Automation approach gives AP teams more than payment automation. It removes the operational burden around supplier servicing, managing exceptions, reconciliation, and fraud risk mitigation, so AP teams can spend less time chasing payments and more time focusing on higher-value work.”


Corpay will be available in the SuiteWorld Expo Hall to meet with attendees and discuss how full-service AP Automation can help NetSuite users streamline the entire AP process from automating payment processing through the “last mile” of post-payment support.


**About Corpay** Corpay (NYSE: CPAY), the Global Spend Management Company, is an S&P 500 company with three primary B2B solution sets. Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and automates procure-to-pay. Cross-Border, converts foreign currencies and establishes foreign bank accounts. Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, the more a business controls, the less it spends.
